entries.head: logql
entries.rationale: resolveLogSampleShape reaches this guard only after an internally produced plan claims the Sample contract with RoleMetricName. ProjectSamples, checkedVariantPlan, and logSampleColumns receive plans from LogQL lowering, whose sample-producing projections use logRoles to publish all four required roles with fixed non-empty names. A missing role therefore means an internal plan producer violated that closed Sample-schema contract; no query syntax can selectively remove a declared output role.

entries.head: logql
entries.message: logql: sample layout requires one named column for role %d
entries.rationale: resolveLogSampleShape reaches this guard only after an internally produced plan claims the Sample contract with RoleMetricName. ProjectSamples, checkedVariantPlan, and logSampleColumns receive plans from LogQL lowering, whose sample-producing projections use logRoles to publish each required role exactly once under a fixed non-empty name. An unnamed or duplicate role therefore means an internal plan producer violated that schema contract; query syntax cannot alter role declarations.

entries.head: logql
entries.message: logql: sample layout requires closed schema
entries.rationale: resolveLogSampleShape reaches this guard only when an internally produced plan declares RoleMetricName and thereby claims the public Sample contract. ProjectSamples, checkedVariantPlan, and logSampleColumns receive plans from LogQL lowering, whose sample-producing projections use logRoles and publish a closed schema. An open schema carrying that claim therefore indicates an internal RowType producer-contract violation, not a query-controlled rejection.

entries.head: logql
entries.message: logql: sample layout roles %d and %d share output %q
entries.rationale: resolveLogSampleShape reaches this guard only after an internally produced plan claims the Sample contract and supplies every required role. ProjectSamples, checkedVariantPlan, and logSampleColumns receive plans from LogQL lowering, whose sample-producing projections use logRoles to assign distinct fixed output names. Two semantic roles sharing one physical output therefore means an internal plan producer violated that schema contract; query syntax cannot choose these aliases.

guard: if previous, exists := physicalRoles[names[role]]; exists && previous != role
